reuse.why: Hooks the flag into the shared linkExternalAccount and the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked check, but re-writes the unlink field reset instead of reusing (or extracting from) unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount reset is copied verbatim from unlinkAccount, so 'what an unlinked account looks like' now lives in two places.

placement.why: The takeover is handled in linkExternalAccount, the single path every provider link goes through, before any bank is created.

scope.why: Only the flag, the check and the takeover are touched.

maintainability.why: An 'assert' function that now returns the holder id when a flag is set is a confusing contract, and the copied reset can drift from unlinkAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: linkExternalAccount clears the previous holder with its own db.updateAccount block instead of going through unlinkAccount (e.g. a variant that skips the provider cleanup).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied reset block is a verbatim copy, not disguised.
